steps.step: UE initiates the registration procedure for initial registration by sending a REGISTRATION REQUEST message to the AMF.
If timer T3502 is running, UE stops timer T3502.
If timer T3511 is running, UE stops timer T3511.
If SUCI is included in the REGISTRATION REQUEST and timer T3519 is not running, UE starts timer T3519.
AMF may initiate 5GMM common procedures (e.g., authentication, security).
If the initial registration request is accepted, AMF sends a REGISTRATION ACCEPT message to the UE (containing e.g., 5G-GUTI, TAI list, Allowed NSSAI, 5GS network feature support).

If acknowledgement is required (e.g., due to 5G-GUTI, SOR container, Operator-defined access category definitions, CAG information list, Negotiated PEIPS assistance information, UE radio capability ID, Truncated 5G-S-TMSI configuration, service-level-AA pending, NSSAI updates being included in REGISTRATION ACCEPT), AMF starts timer T3550 and enters state 5GMM-COMMON-PROCEDURE-INITIATED.
Upon receipt of REGISTRATION ACCEPT, UE stops timer T3510, resets the registration attempt counter, enters state 5GMM-REGISTERED, and sets the 5GS update status to 5U1 UPDATED.
If acknowledgement was required by the AMF (based on content in REGISTRATION ACCEPT), UE sends a REGISTRATION COMPLETE message to the AMF.
Upon receipt of REGISTRATION COMPLETE, AMF stops timer T3550 and changes to state 5GMM-REGISTERED.
Alternatively, if the initial registration request cannot be accepted, AMF sends a REGISTRATION REJECT message to the UE (including a 5GMM cause).

Upon receipt of REGISTRATION REJECT, UE stops timer T3510 and performs actions based on the 5GMM cause value (e.g., starts T3346 for cause #22, stores forbidden PLMN/TAI, enters appropriate 5GMM-DEREGISTERED substate like ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION, PLMN-SEARCH, LIMITED-SERVICE, NO-SUPI).

If T3510 expires (timeout), UE aborts the procedure, stops T3510, increments the registration attempt counter. If counter < 5, starts T3511 and enters 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION. If counter = 5, deletes context, starts T3502 (if > 0), sets status 5U2 NOT UPDATED, enters 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION or PLMN-SEARCH.
